universities/ucla/gpa-calculator.name: University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA)
universities/ucla/gpa-calculator.scope: University grade points; repetition rules depend on units and the student's record.
universities/ucla/gpa-calculator.formula: GPA = total grade points ÷ total GPA units
notes: UCLA assigns A+ and A 4.0 grade points per unit; plus/minus values continue through D−.
Passed grades do not add grade points to GPA.
Course repetition treatment changes after the published unit threshold, so the repeat policy must be checked before estimating a new GPA.

universities/university-of-texas-at-aust.name: The University of Texas at Austin
universities/university-of-texas-at-aust.scope: Undergraduate and graduate planning; the official calculator excludes Law.
universities/university-of-texas-at-aust.formula: GPA = total grade points ÷ total GPA hours
notes: The Registrar authorizes A and A−, B+, B and B−, C+, C and C−, D+, D and D−, and F.
The official UT Austin calculator warns that its result is not the official University GPA.
Law grading is outside the scope of the general calculator.

sources.label: UT Austin Registrar — Grade and Symbol Details

universities/universiti-malaya/gpa-calcu.name: Universiti Malaya
universities/universiti-malaya/gpa-calcu.scope: Bachelor's grading scheme; programme and level regulations can differ.
universities/universiti-malaya/gpa-calcu.formula: GPA = total grade points obtained ÷ total credits taken in the semester
notes: The official 2025/2026 scheme assigns A+ and A 4.00, A− 3.70, B+ 3.30, B 3.00, and B− 2.70.
The published bachelor's scheme identifies C as a pass in the cited faculty handbook.
Foundation and postgraduate schemes may use different point values, so degree level must be verified.

sources.label: UM Faculty of Science Handbook 2025/2026 — Grading Scheme

universities/aastmt/gpa-calculator.name: Arab Academy for Science, Technology and Maritime Transport (AASTMT)
universities/aastmt/gpa-calculator.scope: AASTMT uses college- and programme-specific thresholds; no single percentage table is applied to every student.
universities/aastmt/gpa-calculator.formula: GPA = total grade points accumulated ÷ total semester hours attempted
notes: Official AASTMT pages state that GPA is credit weighted on a 0–4.0 scale.
Percentage boundaries and conditional-pass rules differ between colleges and programmes.
Select the applicable college regulation and catalog year before using a preset.

universities/king-saud-university/gpa-ca.name: King Saud University
universities/king-saud-university/gpa-ca.scope: General 5.0 scale; programme progression rules may add requirements.
universities/king-saud-university/gpa-ca.formula: GPA = total points score ÷ total credit hours
notes: The published scale assigns A+ 5.00, A 4.75, B+ 4.50, B 4.00, C+ 3.50, C 3.00, D+ 2.50, and D 2.00.
Incomplete and in-progress course symbols have special timing and conversion rules.
Programme handbooks may impose minimum course or progression grades beyond the general GPA scale.

sources.label: KSU — Regulations of Study and Examinations
KSU College of Sciences — Academic System and GPA Formula

universities/united-arab-emirates-univer.name: United Arab Emirates University (UAEU)
universities/united-arab-emirates-univer.catalogYear: Current catalog and official policy reviewed July 2026
universities/united-arab-emirates-univer.scope: General 4.00 quality-point policy; programme and graduate rules can differ.
universities/united-arab-emirates-univer.formula: GPA = sum(course quality points × credit hours) ÷ total GPA credit hours
notes: UAEU describes GPA as a 4.00 quality-point scale weighted by course credit hours.
The Registrar reports semester and cumulative GPA to two decimal places.
Degree completion also depends on credit and programme requirements, not GPA alone.

official/cairo-university.name: Cairo University
official/cairo-university.scope: Faculties publish separate programme bylaws; no universal Cairo University GPA table is assumed.
official/cairo-university.formula: Use the formula and classifications in the applicable faculty bylaw.
notes: Programme credits, grading and transfer recognition must be checked against the student's faculty and catalog year.

official/american-university-in-cairo.name: The American University in Cairo
official/american-university-in-cairo.scope: Undergraduate academic requirements, repeats, withdrawals and transfer credit.
official/american-university-in-cairo.formula: GPA = total quality points ÷ total GPA credit hours
notes: Repeat and transfer rules must be applied from the current catalog rather than inferred from the scale alone.

official/qatar-university.name: Qatar University
official/qatar-university.scope: Current undergraduate catalog, registration rules and programme requirements.
official/qatar-university.formula: Use the current catalog's credit-weighted GPA rule.
notes: Withdrawal and degree requirements depend on current deadlines and programme rules.

official/kuwait-university.name: Kuwait University
official/kuwait-university.scope: University credit-system bylaw plus the receiving college's rules.
official/kuwait-university.formula: Use the applicable college grading and credit-unit bylaw.
notes: Transfer and recognized-credit decisions remain with the university and receiving college.

official/sultan-qaboos-university.name: Sultan Qaboos University
official/sultan-qaboos-university.scope: Undergraduate academic regulations and applicable college bulletin.
official/sultan-qaboos-university.formula: GPA uses the university's credit-weighted grade-point rule.
notes: Repeat, withdrawal and progression treatment must follow the student's programme regulation.

official/mit.name: Massachusetts Institute of Technology
official/mit.scope: MIT undergraduate grading, units, repeats and transfer-credit treatment.
official/mit.formula: MIT rating = total grade points weighted by subject units ÷ total graded units
notes: Approved transfer credit carries units but no MIT grade; repeated grades remain in the GPA record.

official/unsw-sydney.name: UNSW Sydney
official/unsw-sydney.catalogYear: Current results and WAM guidance reviewed August 2026
official/unsw-sydney.scope: UNSW marks, grade symbols and Weighted Average Mark rules.
official/unsw-sydney.formula: WAM = sum(course mark × units of credit) ÷ eligible units attempted
notes: UNSW states that WAM, not one universal GPA, is its primary weighted result.

official/university-of-british-columbia.name: The University of British Columbia
official/university-of-british-columbia.scope: UBC percentage and letter grades with faculty-specific average and standing rules.
official/university-of-british-columbia.formula: Use the applicable faculty's weighted-average and standing rules.
notes: Faculty and programme rules control progression, repeats and withdrawals.

official/university-of-oxford.name: University of Oxford
official/university-of-oxford.scope: Assessment conventions and classifications depend on the examination and programme.
official/university-of-oxford.formula: Use the course's published examination conventions; no generic Oxford GPA is assumed.
notes: Final classification and resits must be evaluated under the applicable examination regulations.

official/national-university-of-singapor.name: National University of Singapore
official/national-university-of-singapor.scope: NUS grading, S/U, withdrawal and unit-weighted GPA rules.
official/national-university-of-singapor.formula: GPA = sum(grade point × course units) ÷ total graded course units
notes: S/U results are excluded from GPA but remain subject to programme and option limits.

official/king-abdulaziz-university.name: King Abdulaziz University
official/king-abdulaziz-university.scope: General undergraduate regulations plus college and programme requirements.
official/king-abdulaziz-university.formula: GPA = credit-weighted average on the official 5.0 scale
notes: Course repetition and graduation conditions must follow the current university regulation and college plan.

official/university-of-toronto.name: University of Toronto
official/university-of-toronto.scope: Faculty of Arts & Science; other divisions publish separate calendars.
official/university-of-toronto.formula: Use the faculty calendar's credit-weighted grade-point rules.
notes: Degree requirements depend on faculty, programme combination and catalog year.

sources.label: U of T Arts & Science academic calendar
